steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: This short tutorial walks you through a turn. Follow the highlights — only the suggested actions will work.

steps.title: Take a pack
steps.body: Click one of the landscape packs at the bottom-left to add cards to your hand.

steps.title: Select a landscape
steps.body: Click a landscape card in your hand to select it.

steps.title: Place it
steps.body: Hover a hex to preview scoring, then click an empty hex to place your landscape.

steps.title: Score
steps.body: Your score updates at the top-left. Landscape groups score using this run's pinned rules — open the book icon anytime for details.

steps.title: Undo
steps.body: Made a mistake? Use Undo (bottom-right) to take back your last placement. Try it now, or press Continue to skip.

steps.title: Place again
steps.body: Select a landscape and place it once more so you have a tile on the board.

steps.title: Animals
steps.body: Open the animal market (arrow above the packs) and take an animal into your hand.

steps.title: Select an animal
steps.body: Click the animal card in your hand.

steps.title: Place the animal
steps.body: Place the animal on a valid habitat hex (matching its placement rules).

steps.title: Recycle
steps.body: If your hand gets too full, select an animal and use Recycle (under Undo) to discard it. Continue when ready.

steps.title: You're ready
steps.body: That's the core loop: packs → place landscapes → animals → score. The full diagram guide stays available from the book icon.
